passages.original: O vere vates, inquit, O Solon, Solon
passages.english: "O true prophet," he said, "O Solon, Solon!"
passages.notes: Verse line (iambic senarius); the speaker is presumably Croesus on the pyre, recalling Solon's warning.

passages.original: laudat Solonem: Croesum inde in amicis habet
passages.english: he praises Solon; from then on he counts Croesus among his friends
passages.notes: The subject is presumably Cyrus, who on hearing Croesus' cry spared him; the context does not name him.

passages.english: I said [it was the first principle] for creating things, as the poet Pindar [did].
